```artifact
Feature: Doctor Consultation and Prescription

  Scenario: Doctor can view appointments/consultation request pending in his list
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor views his list of pending consultations
    Then the patient's consultation request is displayed in the list

  Scenario: Consultation is provided by the doctor and prescription is generated
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor provides a consultation to the patient
    And the doctor generates a prescription for the patient
    Then the consultation and prescription are recorded in the system

  Scenario: Doctors can prescribe lab tests
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor prescribes a lab test for the patient
    Then the lab test is created and the lab is requested to perform the test

  Scenario: Lab Test for the patient is created and lab is requested to perform the lab test
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor prescribes a lab test for the patient
    Then the lab test is created and the lab is requested to perform the test

  Scenario: Doctors can prescribe medicines
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor prescribes medicines for the patient
    Then the medicines are requested to the concerned Chemist for delivery

  Scenario: Medicines for the patient are requested to the concerned Chemist for delivery
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor prescribes medicines for the patient
    Then the medicines are requested to the concerned Chemist for delivery

  Scenario: Lab tests are performed and reports for corresponding patient are updated (Offline)
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    And a lab test has been prescribed for the patient
    When the lab performs the test and updates the report
    Then the report is updated in the system for the patient

  Scenario: Lab report for the patient is released to view (Offline)
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    And a lab test has been prescribed for the patient
    And the lab report has been updated
    When the doctor releases the lab report for the patient to view
    Then the lab report is displayed to the patient

  Scenario Outline: Normal, Edge, and Invalid Values
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor prescribes a <prescription_type> for the patient
    Then the <prescription_type> is created and the <lab_or_chemist> is requested to perform the test or deliver the medicines

    Examples:
      | prescription_type | lab_or_chemist |
      | Lab Test          | Lab             |
      | Medicines         | Chemist         |
      | Invalid Value     | Invalid Value   |

  Scenario Outline: Negative/ Error Paths and Boundary Values
    Given a doctor is logged in
    And there is a patient with a consultation request pending
    When the doctor tries to prescribe a <prescription_type> for the patient with an invalid <input_value>
    Then an error message is displayed to the doctor

    Examples:
      | prescription_type | input_value |
      | Lab Test          | Invalid Value |
      | Medicines         | Invalid Value |
      | Invalid Value     | Invalid Value |
```
